data.name: Raimonda
data.gender_notes: Raimonda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Raimonda is derived from the name Raymond, which means ‘protector of the people’ or ‘wise protector’. This name was borne by Saint Raimond of Penyafort, a 13th-century jurist and patron saint of merchants and students. The name Raimonda carries the meaning “Protector of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Raimonda usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Raimonda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raimonda total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: ריימונדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמה 'ריימונדה' ממקור 'רמונד' שמשמעות 'עצמות' או 'הדר' בעברית. מקור מאוחר של שמה. ישנה עדות לאזכור שמה 'ריימונד' באנגלית במאה ה-13. ביהדות, 'רמונד' יכול לייצג 'מספר', 'גודל' ו'צד'. השם 'ריימונדה' נפוץ בכנסיות קתוליות ופרוטסטנטיות. השם קשור ל'ראימונד', שהיה בעבר שמו של מלך. עדות לאזכור תרבותי של השם 'ריימונדה' ניתן לראות ב'מסעי אגרון', שהפך לספר הנסיך. כנסיות באירופה וארצות הברית רשמו שמות 'ריימונד' שונים, אך 'ריימונדה' נמצא בשימוש.

in_greek.name: Ραιμόνδα
in_greek.meaning: שמά το όνομα Ραιμόνδα έχει την σημασία της 'επαίνους' ή 'αυτάρκεια'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ραιμόνδα προέρχεται από την ηπειρωτική γλώσσα και έχει την σημασία της 'επαίνους' ή 'αυτάρκεια'. Είναι ένα όνομα που χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως στη δυτική Ευρώπη. Η ρίζα του ονόματος είναι το ρήμα 'ραϊμουν' που σημαίνει 'να λατρέψει'. Είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την αρετή της αρεσκείας και την ευχαρίστηση. Μια άλλη ερμηνεία του ονόματος είναι ότι προέρχεται από το ρήμα 'ραίμο' που σημαίνει 'να είναι ανεξάρτητος'. Η ονομασία Ραιμόνδα είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την αρετή της αυτάρκειας και την ευχαρίστηση.

in_latin.name: Raimonda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Raimonda originem habet in lingua Romana et significat 'laus' aut 'felicitas'. Est nomen commune in Europa occidentali. Radix nominis est verbum 'raimundus' quod significat 'qui laudatur'. Nomen Raimonda connexum est cum virtute laudis et felicitatis. Alia interpretatio nominis est quod provenit a verbo 'raimundare' quod significat 'qui est liber'. Nomen Raimonda est nomen commune in Ecclesia Catholica et Ecclesia Protestante. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen Raimonda est usum habuit. In cultura populari, nomen Raimonda est usum habuit. Nomen Raimonda est nomen commune in Europa occidentali.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Raimonda has its roots in the Old French language and means 'praise' or 'joy'. It is a common name in Western Europe and is associated with the virtue of praise and joy. Another interpretation of the name is that it comes from the verb 'raimundare' which means 'to be free'. The name Raimonda is a common name in Catholic and Protestant churches. In Christian tradition, the name Raimonda has been used since the Middle Ages. In popular culture, the name Raimonda has been used as a character name in 'The Pilgrim's Progress'. The name Raimonda is a common name in Western Europe and is associated with the virtue of praise and joy.

data.cultural_impact: Raimonda is a beautiful and significant name in Christian culture. It's a reminder of the protective and wise nature of God, who watches over and guides His people. The name Raimonda carries the legacy of saints like Raimond of Penyafort, who used their wisdom and strength to protect and serve others.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Raimonda is a reflection of our spiritual identity as children of God. We are all called to be protectors and witnesses of His love in our communities, families, and even in the smallest interactions. Just as the name Raimond derives from the Latin roots 'wise' and 'protector', we, too, are called to be wise and protectors in God's kingdom. In embracing this name, we are invited to reflect on our own callings to be loving, wise, and strong, always looking for opportunities to support and uplift those around us. It's a reminder of the trust we place in God as our ultimate protector and the wise love He shows towards us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Raimonda, meaning "protector of the people" in Old German, symbolizes the divine guardianship and strength of the Christian faith, reminding us that even in times of adversity, God is our shield and refuge.

historical_references.reference: Raimonda of Tuscany, daughter of Count Guido I of the House of Canossa, was a powerful abbess and patron of the arts in the 11th century.
